Junior Software Engineer - Mobile
United States
Full-time
Remote
Entry Level
$70K/yr - $80K/yr
Pulsara develops healthcare communication and care-coordination technology. The Junior Software Engineer – Mobile will develop and improve native Android and iOS applications, troubleshoot issues, collaborate with product and engineering teammates, and build reliable, intuitive mobile experiences for healthcare professionals.
Apps
Cloud Computing
Healthcare
Software
Health Care
No H1B
Responsibilities
Develop features, maintain functionality, and write clean, reliable code for our native Android and iOS applications
Use tools such as Android Studio and Xcode. Submit pull requests, participate in code reviews, and apply feedback to strengthen your skills and your code
Use AI tools to support coding, debugging, testing, and problem-solving. Learn to evaluate AI-generated code and apply sound engineering judgment
Investigate bugs, identify causes, and work with teammates to develop and verify solutions
Work with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Test Engineers to clarify requirements, share ideas, and deliver quality software
Build with usability in mind, considering platform-specific design, customer workflows, and how mobile applications connect to APIs and other services
Explore new technologies, ask thoughtful questions, and improve your skills while recognizing that healthcare professionals depend on the software you build

Required
Hands-on Android and/or iOS development experience through professional work, coursework, or personal projects
Familiarity with Kotlin, Java, Swift, or comparable programming languages
Understanding of basic software development principles and writing clean, maintainable code
Familiarity with Android Studio, Xcode, Git, or similar development tools
Interest in developing native applications for both Android and iOS
Experience using AI-assisted tools in software development
Basic debugging, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills
Appreciation for intuitive design, software quality, and customer experience
Curiosity, attention to detail, clear communication, and a willingness to learn and collaborate
Applicants must reside in the U.S
Must be authorized to work for any U.S. employer without sponsorship, now or in the future
Preferred
A mobile application or software project you've built and can share
Familiarity with Google's Material Design or Apple's Human Interface Guidelines
Exposure to APIs, databases, backend services, web applications, or full-stack development
Experience with Agile development, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, or DevOps
A degree or coursework in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
